descriptor.label: XSD
descriptor.description: Export as a W3C XML Schema Definition (XSD 1.0 or 1.1), a RELAX NG grammar or a DTD.

xsd_version.description: `1.0` (default) or `1.1`. XSD 1.1 marks the schema `vc:minVersion="1.1"` and writes `multipleOf` as an `xs:assertion` facet.
xsd_version.title: Xsd Version

include_comments.description: Emit an XML comment header in the generated XSD.
include_comments.title: Include Comments

mode.description: `xsd` (default) writes XML Schema. `relaxng` writes one RELAX NG grammar in the XML syntax (`<Name>.rng`), `relaxng-compact` the same grammar in the compact syntax (`<Name>.rnc`), and `dtd` one DTD (`<Name>.dtd`). RELAX NG keeps the types and facets; a DTD keeps only element names and content models. What each mode cannot carry is listed in the fidelity report. `xsd_version` applies to `xsd` only.
mode.title: Mode

profile.description: `generic` (default) writes the types as they are. `iso20022` writes an ISO 20022 message definition: one `urn:iso:std:iso:20022:tech:xsd:<message_identifier>` namespace, a `Document` root element wrapping the business element, UpperCamelCase names, descriptions as `xs:documentation`, and a `message-catalog.json` manifest beside `<message_identifier>.xsd`. `xsd` mode only.
profile.title: Profile

message_identifier.description: ISO 20022 profile: the message identifier, `<business area>.<message number>.<variant>.<version>` (`pain.001.001.09`). Defaults to an ISO 20022 source's own; without one, a placeholder (`<business_area>.001.001.01`) is used and reported as synthesized.
message_identifier.title: Message Identifier

business_area.description: ISO 20022 profile: the four-letter business area (`pain`, `pacs`, `camt` …) a placeholder identifier uses. Must match `message_identifier` when both are set.
business_area.title: Business Area

message_type.description: ISO 20022 profile: the record type (name or key) `Document` wraps as the message. Defaults to an ISO 20022 source's business element, else the one record no other record uses.
message_type.title: Message Type
